profile.intro: A Java Backend Developer who builds secure, scalable REST APIs with Spring Boot, Spring Security, Hibernate and PostgreSQL. B.Tech CSE graduate (CGPA 8.1) with 9 months of hands-on full-stack training, and an immediate joiner.

points: Completed 9-month intensive training in Java Full Stack Development: Core Java, Advanced Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
Built 3 full-stack web applications and REST APIs using Spring Boot, Spring Security, JWT authentication, and PostgreSQL/MySQL.
Documented APIs with Swagger/OpenAPI 3.0; used Git with a feature-branch workflow across all projects.

projects.title: MediCare AI
projects.logline: A healthcare chatbot platform that answers patient questions with OpenAI / Gemini and secures every role with JWT.
build: Built a full-stack healthcare chatbot application using Spring Boot 3.2 and Java 17 with PostgreSQL, integrating OpenAI/Gemini APIs to generate intelligent, context-aware responses.
Implemented JWT-based authentication and role-based access control for Patient, Doctor, and Admin roles.
Designed a responsive frontend with HTML, Tailwind CSS, and vanilla JavaScript, including a dark/light mode toggle.
features: AI chatbot with context-aware answers (OpenAI / Gemini)
Responsive UI with dark / light mode

projects.title: EduSphere
projects.logline: A CRUD student management system on Servlets and JDBC with a clean Controller → Service → DAO architecture.
build: Developed a CRUD-based Student Management System using MVC architecture and JDBC PreparedStatements to prevent SQL injection; designed a normalized PostgreSQL schema with indexing for optimized query performance.
Implemented search, filter, and server-side pagination for 500+ records; deployed on Apache Tomcat following Controller → Service → DAO layered architecture.
features: Create, read, update and delete students
